tools.name: read_claim_attachment_text
tools.description: Reads a text attachment (such as an adjuster note or incident statement) stored for a claim and returns its contents.

params.name: claim_id
params.description: Claim identifier whose attachments folder should be used

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the attachment file to read

tools.name: load_policy_template
tools.description: Loads a policy document template by name from the templates directory and returns its JSON contents as an object, with an optional list of top-level fields to include.

params.name: template_name
params.description: Template file name, for example auto_comprehensive.json

params.name: fields
params.description: Optional list of top-level keys to return; all keys if omitted

tools.name: get_damage_photo_metadata
tools.description: Reads the metadata sidecar JSON file for a damage photo in a claim's photo folder and returns the capture date, photographer, and notes recorded for it.

params.name: claim_number
params.description: Claim number used to locate the claim's photo folder

params.name: photo_name
params.description: Photo base name whose .json metadata should be read
